Method of Attack: Remote code execution (RCE) via improper origin validation weakness
Remote code execution (RCE) via triggering buggy program to download and execute arbitrary files without user interaction
Privilege escalation from non-admin users to kernel privileges
Impacted Systems: Dell devices running Windows operating system
129 Dell models of consumer and business laptops, desktops, and tablets including devices protected by Secure Boot and Dell Secured-core PCs
Tens of millions of Dell devices
Attack Vector: SupportAssist software preinstalled on Dell devices
DBUtil driver shipped with Dell devices
Indicators of Compromise: High-severity SupportAssist remote code execution vulnerability
Privilege escalation bug in DBUtil driver
